responsibility: This file defines the AArch64-specific machine modes used by the backend, including custom condition-code modes, half-precision and bfloat16 scalar modes, fixed-size AdvSIMD vector and structure modes, and scalable SVE vector and predicate-related modes. It is the authoritative specification of how GCC names and sizes these modes, including scalable element counts and alignments derived from aarch64_sve_vg, so surrounding code generation, builtin typing, and RTL patterns can share one consistent mode vocabulary.
